terms.comment: In exclamations, the accusative: Mē miserum!, poor me!; Miseram Mārcellam!, poor Marcella! (Traupman 23).

terms.register: vōx sermōnis cotīdiānī: Catull.; Cic. in epistulīs

phrases.latin: ō factum male! ō miselle passer!
phrases.english: oh, what a shame! poor little sparrow!

phrases.latin: pōma sumus Cybelēs: procul hinc discēde, viātor, nē cadat in miserum nostra ruīna caput
phrases.english: we are Cybele’s fruit: keep away, traveller, or we’ll fall on your poor head

sources: Lewis & Short: miser · Lewis & Short: misellus
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, pp. 23, 156, 363, checked against the searchable text of the book (9 November 2026).
